case_number: 2023INSC795; TC (CRL) NO. 1 OF 2016; TC (CRL) NO. 3 OF 2016; W.P. (CRL) NO. 326 OF 2023
summary: Bail applications in siphoning case exceeding ₹40,000 crores; multiple complaints investigated by different agencies; CBI case registration under SC direction; bail granted in co-accused cases; interim relief extended for 3 months to file before jurisdictional courts; liberty to apply for bail in respective courts; no tampering of evidence claimed; CBI opposed on grounds of money trail complexity and public impact.
legal_provisions_cited: Prize Chits and Money Circulation Scheme (Banning) Act, 1978 s.4, s.5, s.6
final_judgment: Applications dismissed; writ petition dismissed; interim bail extended for 3 months; liberty to seek bail from concerned courts on individual merits.
